low.next_step: Re-check your risk in about a year.

high.what_this_means: Based on your answers, your estimated risk is higher than most people in the survey data we learned from. This is a screening estimate, not a diagnosis.

timeline.high: Within 2 weeks: book a fasting blood glucose or HbA1c test. Bring this report to your doctor.

blood_tests.explanation: Fasting blood glucose and HbA1c are the common tests used to check blood sugar levels. A doctor reviews the results and decides what they mean. This tool does not provide diagnostic cut-offs for self-interpretation.

share_with_doctor: Bring this report and ask for a fasting blood glucose or HbA1c test.
disclaimer: This is an AI-based screening estimate based on survey data from US adults, not a medical diagnosis. It does not replace advice from a qualified doctor.
